title: hopea helferi
intro: Hopea helferi, commonly known as the Philippine ironwood, is a species of tree in the family Dipterocarpaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Hopea helferi are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including iriflophenone, iriflophenone C, and 3-epi-catechin, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. However, more research is needed to fully understand the therapeutic potential of Hopea helferi and its bioactive constituents.
